ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:0.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:0.original: Here I am, at the church... I wonder if there are any pretty ladies around here?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:0.translation: Вот я и в церкви... Интересно, есть ли здесь хорошенькие дамы?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:1.speaker: Grace
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:1.original: I need some carrots and some onions. Hehe, I'm going to cook up a delicious curry!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:1.translation: Мне нужны морковь и лук. Хе-хе, приготовлю вкусный карри!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:2.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:2.original: Hello, my divine dear. You have such a mysterious air about you! Such a biblical beauty!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:2.translation: Здравствуй, моя божественная. В тебе такая загадочная аура! Такая библейская красота!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:3.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:3.original: I'm sure a curry made by your angelic hands would taste delicious. Especially if we ate it together.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:3.translation: Уверен, карри, приготовленное твоими ангельскими руками, будет восхитительным. Особенно если съедим его вместе.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:4.speaker: Grace
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:4.original: Hehe, aren't you a smooth talker! And wasting your talents on an old maid like me.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:4.translation: Хе-хе, какой же ты краснобай! И тратишь таланты на такую старую деву, как я.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:5.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:5.original: Old maid? Please, if you wish to reject me, I can take it. No need to bend the truth...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:5.translation: Старая дева? Пожалуйста, если хочешь меня отвергнуть — я приму это. Не надо искажать правду...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:6.speaker: Grace
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:6.original: By my vow to the divine, I am not lying! I am in my fifties, I'll have you know.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:6.translation: Клянусь божественным — я не лгу! Мне за пятьдесят, имей в виду.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:7.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:7.original: You are? That's older than my mother! But you don't look it at all...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:7.translation: Правда? Это старше моей матери! Но ты совсем так не выглядишь...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:8.speaker: Grace
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:8.original: Regardless of what you see, it's the truth. Why don't you try picking up someone younger, hummm?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:8.translation: Что бы ты ни видел — это правда. Почему бы тебе не попробовать подобрать кого помоложе, хммм?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:9.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:9.original: N-No! A master pickup artist doesn't back down just because he hears the age of the one he's after!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:9.translation: Н-нет! Мастер пикапа не отступает только потому, что услышал возраст своей цели!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:10.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:10.original: I approached you because I was struck by your beauty. That's all there is to this!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:10.translation: Я подошёл к тебе, потому что меня поразила твоя красота. Вот и всё!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:11.speaker: Grace
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:11.original: Oh, my! How about this, then?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:11.translation: О боже! А как насчёт вот чего?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:12.speaker: Grace
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:12.original: Let's go shopping together, and then have some curry back at the church. How does that sound?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:12.translation: Давай вместе сходим за покупками, а потом поедим карри в церкви. Как тебе?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:13.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:13.original: S-Sure, that sounds fine. I'll help you carry the shopping bags.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:13.translation: К-конечно, звучит нормально. Я помогу нести сумки.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:14.speaker: Grace
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:14.original: Thanks, that's a big help. Shall we?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:15.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:15.original: Hmm, this is odd. How did things turn out like this? I need to hone my skills further!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_010.ebm:15.translation: Хм, странно. Как всё так обернулось? Нужно дальше оттачивать навыки!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:0.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:0.original: Firis. Is this the place to plant these seeds?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:1.original: Perfect, Miss Sophie! She'll love it there, with all those other friends!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:1.translation: Идеально, мисс Софи! Ей здесь понравится — со всеми этими друзьями!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:3.original: Phew! Thanks for your help, Miss Sophie!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:3.translation: Уф! Спасибо за помощь, мисс Софи!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:4.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:4.original: Oh, think nothing of it. I've got a bone to pick with Oskar, though!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:4.translation: Ой, пустяки. А вот с Оскаром у меня разговор!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:5.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:5.original: Taking half your seeds and going off on his own! How selfish!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:5.translation: Взял половину твоих семян и ушёл сам! Какой эгоист!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:6.original: Don't be too hard on him. He was all fired up to scatter those seeds across the world!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:6.translation: Не будь слишком строга к нему. Он так загорелся разбросать эти семена по всему миру!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:7.original: I bet he's roamed far and wide by now, making friends for her everywhere he goes!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:7.translation: Бьюсь об заклад, он уже бродит повсюду и заводит для неё друзей, куда бы ни пошёл!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:8.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:8.original: Hehe, I bet you're right. Oskar can really set his mind to something, can't he!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:8.translation: Хе-хе, наверное, ты права. Оскар умеет взяться за дело всерьёз, правда!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:9.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:9.original: Right. Let's water and fertilize these and then get back to the atelier.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:9.translation: Ладно. Польём и удобрим их — и обратно в ателье.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:10.original: Good idea! Chelsea. You grow up big and strong here, surrounded by all your friends!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_020.ebm:10.translation: Хорошая идея! Челси. Расти здесь большой и сильной, в окружении всех своих друзей!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:0.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:0.original: I call our regular parental meeting to order! First order of business, we have a new member.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:0.translation: Открываю наше очередное родительское собрание! Первый вопрос — у нас новый участник.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:3.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:3.original: Ilmeria?! When did you find the time to have some kids?!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:3.translation: Ильмерия?! Когда ты успела завести детей?!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:4.original: I didn't! I'm here for Lydie and Sue! Those two are my students.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:4.translation: Я не заводила! Я здесь ради Лиди и Сью! Эти двое — мои ученицы.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:5.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:5.original: Which means I'm kind of like their parent. Which means I have every right to be here!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:5.translation: Значит, я вроде как их родитель. А значит, имею полное право быть здесь!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:6.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:6.original: Her reasoning seems sound to me. What do you think, Liane?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:6.translation: Её доводы кажутся мне здравыми. Что скажешь, Лианэ?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:7.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:7.original: Of course, she's more than welcome. How about you start us off today, then?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:7.translation: Конечно, она более чем желанный гость. Может, сегодня начнёшь ты?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:8.original: Of course. Ah, Lydie, first! She finally started holding the mixing stick one handed...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:8.translation: Конечно. Ах, Лиди, сначала! Наконец-то она начала держать палочку для смешивания одной рукой...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:9.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:9.original: And that's how Sophie learnt to fold the laundry!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:9.translation: Вот так Софи научилась складывать бельё!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:10.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:10.original: Amazing! Almost as impressive as Firis finally starting to eat her vegetables!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:10.translation: Потрясающе! Почти так же впечатляюще, как то, что Фирис наконец начала есть овощи!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:11.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:11.original: Sue could learn a thing or two from them. She still can't bear to touch bugs. Ah, the time!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:11.translation: Сью могла бы у них кое-чему поучиться. Она до сих пор не может прикасаться к жукам. Ах, время!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:12.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:12.original: It always flies by when you're having fun. I think that brings this meeting to an end.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:12.translation: Когда весело, оно всегда пролетает незаметно. Думаю, на этом собрание можно закрыть.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:13.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:13.original: The next one is tomorrow, at the same time. I look forward to it.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_030.ebm:13.translation: Следующее — завтра в то же время. С нетерпением жду.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:0.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:0.original: Lydie, Sue! I've had a good catch, so I wanted to share it with... hummm, they're not here?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:0.translation: Лиди, Сью! У меня хороший улов, хотела поделиться с... хммм, их нет?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:2.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:2.original: Hello? Is that someone calling my name?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:2.translation: Ау? Кто-то зовёт меня по имени?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:3.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:3.original: (You are Liane, aren't you? Sorry, but could you come and talk with me a little?)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:3.translation: (Ты Лианэ, верно? Извини, не могла бы ты подойти и немного со мной поговорить?)

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:5.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:5.original: (Welcome! I am Honnete. I'm Lydie and Suelle's mother.)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:5.translation: (Добро пожаловать! Я Оннет. Я мать Лиди и Сюэль.)

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:6.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:6.original: Of course, the mother in the painting! Nice to meet you. I'm Liane.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:6.translation: Конечно, мать на картине! Приятно познакомиться. Я Лианэ.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:7.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:7.original: What did you want to talk about, then?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:7.translation: О чём же ты хотела поговорить?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:8.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:8.original: (I've heard about how much you love your sister. I'm just as crazy about my own girls.)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:8.translation: (Я слышала, как сильно ты любишь сестру. Я так же без ума от своих девочек.)

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:9.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:9.original: (What do you say? Care to compare notes about our love for our families?)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:9.translation: (Что скажешь? Сравним заметки о нашей любви к семьям?)

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:10.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:10.original: You bet I do! Here we go!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:11.original: We're back! Phew, that was a lot of shopping. Hold on, is someone in the basement?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:11.translation: Мы вернулись! Уф, сколько покупок. Погоди, кто-то в подвале?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:12.original: That sounds like mom! I've got a bad feeling about this.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:12.translation: Похоже на маму! У меня плохое предчувствие.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:13.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:13.original: Haha, Firis was just being so cute, I thought I was going to pass out!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:13.translation: Ха-ха, Фирис была такая милая, я думала, потеряю сознание!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:14.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:14.original: (I know the feeling! Totally! We're just powerless when faced with something cute, aren't we?)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:14.translation: (Знаю это чувство! Абсолютно! Мы просто бессильны перед милотой, правда?)

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:15.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:15.original: L-Liane is talking to a painting? She has finally lost her marbles?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:15.translation: Л-Лианэ разговаривает с картиной? Она окончательно рехнулась?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:16.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:16.original: No. I think she's talking to our mom?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:16.translation: Нет. Думаю, она разговаривает с нашей мамой?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:17.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:17.original: Though I have absolutely no idea how that could've possibly happened...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:17.translation: Хотя я понятия не имею, как такое вообще могло случиться...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:18.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:18.original: I'm the same way! She looks so fierce when she's angry!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:18.translation: Я такая же! Она выглядит такой свирепой, когда злится!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:19.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:19.original: (Sometimes I'll tease them just to see it! Ah, they are so cute!)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:19.translation: (Иногда я их дразню, просто чтобы это увидеть! Ах, какие милые!)

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:20.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:20.original: Let's leave them to it, Sue. I think they'll be here a while...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:20.translation: Оставим их, Сью. Думаю, они тут ещё надолго...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:21.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:21.original: Y-Yeah, looks like. Have at it, ladies.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:22.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:22.original: So cute! So sweet! Ah, Firis!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:22.translation: Как мило! Как сладко! Ах, Фирис!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:23.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:23.original: (My darling Lydie! My dear Suelle! I just want to hug you to bits!)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:23.translation: (Моя дорогая Лиди! Моя дорогая Сюэль! Так и хочется вас разорвать в объятиях!)

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:24.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:24.original: (Ah, come and see me again soon! I'm waiting here for you, girls!)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_040.ebm:24.translation: (Ах, заходите ко мне скорее! Я жду вас здесь, девочки!)

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:1.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:1.original: Hello, Sue! This is rare, you're here on your own?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:1.translation: Привет, Сью! Редкость — ты здесь одна?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:2.original: Yes, I just sneaked out. Please, will you teach me how to cook?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:2.translation: Да, я только что ускользнула. Пожалуйста, научишь меня готовить?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:3.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:3.original: My! What's brought this on so suddenly?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:4.original: Firis told us about how you hate housework but are great at cooking.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:4.translation: Фирис рассказывала, что ты ненавидишь работу по дому, но отлично готовишь.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:5.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:5.original: Gah! A bit of a barbed compliment, that one.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:6.original: I always leave the cooking up to Lydie, so I'd like to be able to make something.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:6.translation: Готовку я всегда оставляю Лиди, и хотелось бы уметь хоть что-то.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:7.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:7.original: Well said, Sue! OK! I'll teach you everything you need to know. First...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:7.translation: Хорошо сказано, Сью! Ладно! Научу тебя всему нужному. Сначала...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:8.original: I'm so sorry. You took the time to teach me, but all I made are cinders...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:8.translation: Мне очень жаль. Ты потратила время, чтобы меня научить, а я сделала одни угли...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:9.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:9.original: Hahaha! It was even worse than I expected, but don't worry about it!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:9.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Вышло даже хуже, чем я ожидала, но не переживай!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:10.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:10.original: I've got some advice for you, don't worry. First, you need to stay calm.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:10.translation: У меня есть для тебя советы, не волнуйся. Во-первых, сохраняй спокойствие.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:11.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:11.original: Second, think about who you are making it for. Finally, and most importantly...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:11.translation: Во-вторых, думай, для кого готовишь. И наконец, самое главное...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:12.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:12.original: Don't leave the heat on full the entire time! That'll burn it! That'll burn anything!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:12.translation: Не держи огонь на максимуме всё время! Так всё сгорит! Сгорит что угодно!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:13.original: It will? I thought I was just saving time!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:13.translation: Правда? А я думала, просто экономлю время!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:14.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:14.original: No, you're not! Burning it wastes time!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:15.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:15.original: Anyway, give my advice a try. You'll be cooking up a storm in no time, I'm sure.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:15.translation: В любом случае, попробуй мой совет. Уверена, скоро ты будешь готовить на ура.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:16.original: Thanks! I'll head home and give it a try right away.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:16.translation: Спасибо! Пойду домой и сразу попробую.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:17.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:17.original: Hahaha, she reminds me of myself. How many things did I burn to a crisp, when I was younger?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:17.translation: Ха-ха-ха, она напоминает мне меня саму. Сколько всего я спалила дотла, когда была моложе?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:18.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:18.original: That was the same advice my grandma gave me...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:18.translation: Тот же совет дала мне бабушка...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:19.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:19.original: You can do it, Sue! Cooking is all about persistence, and you've got that in spades!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_050.ebm:19.translation: У тебя получится, Сью! Кулинария — это настойчивость, а её у тебя хоть отбавляй!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:0.original: There, the pancakes are ready! I hope Sue enjoys these when she gets back.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:0.translation: Вот, блины готовы! Надеюсь, Сью они понравятся, когда вернётся.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:2.original: Hey, Firis. Welco... uwah, what's that?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:2.translation: Эй, Фирис. Добро... ува, что это?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:3.original: A rabbit roast! My sister made it!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:4.original: It's our mother's recipe, actually. I wanted to share it with you!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:4.translation: На самом деле это рецепт нашей мамы. Хотела поделиться с тобой!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:5.original: Heh, that's quite a coincidence! My mom taught me how to make these pancakes!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:5.translation: Хех, какое совпадение! Моя мама научила меня печь эти блины!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:6.original: She did? So we're both enjoying some of our mom's cooking!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:6.translation: Правда? Значит, мы обе наслаждаемся маминой готовкой!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:7.original: Hahaha, you're right! Say, Firis... Would you like to try a pancake before you go?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:7.translation: Ха-ха-ха, точно! Слушай, Фирис... Хочешь перед уходом попробовать блинчик?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:8.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:8.original: Would that be alright? Thanks, then! Have some rabbit!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:9.original: Thanks! It's a little heavy to have as a snack, but once in a while can't hurt!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:9.translation: Спасибо! Для перекуса тяжеловато, но иногда не повредит!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:10.original: Phew, that was delicious! Your pancakes are great, Lydie!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:10.translation: Уф, как вкусно! Твои блины великолепны, Лиди!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:11.original: The rabbit was wonderful too! I couldn't stop myself!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:11.translation: Кролик тоже замечательный! Не смогла остановиться!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:12.original: Mothers really know their stuff, don't they?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:12.translation: Мамы и правда всё умеют, правда?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:14.original: I'm bac... hold on! That aroma!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:15.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:15.original: Hey, you two! You've been eating nice things while I'm out! No fair!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:15.translation: Эй, вы двое! Поели вкуснятины, пока меня не было! Нечестно!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:16.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:16.original: Wah, Sue! It's not what you think!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:16.translation: Вах, Сью! Всё не так, как ты думаешь!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:17.original: Hah! I'm not listening to your excuses. Make me some pancakes, now, or I'll never forgive you!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:17.translation: Ха! Не слушаю оправданий. Пеки мне блины прямо сейчас, или никогда не прощу!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:18.original: Yes, yes, I don't think I have much choice. Just wait a moment, a hot stack is coming right up.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:18.translation: Да-да, выбора, похоже, нет. Подожди минутку — сейчас будет горячая стопка.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:19.original: Great! I'm so hungry I could eat the plate!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:19.translation: Отлично! Я такая голодная, что могла бы съесть и тарелку!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:20.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:20.original: Hehe, and just like that, they made up. I guess moms really do know best.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_060.ebm:20.translation: Хе-хе, и вот они уже помирились. Мамы и правда всё знают лучше.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:0.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:0.original: I'm coming in, Lucia! Wow, so this is Atelier Borthayre...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:0.translation: Я вхожу, Люсия! Ого, так вот оно — Ателье Бортайр...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:1.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:1.original: Hello, Mathias. You've actually come at just the right moment.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:1.translation: Привет, Матиас. Ты как раз вовремя.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:2.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:2.original: Would you rather drink medicine that's green like pond scum, or a sort of brownish mulberry color?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:2.translation: Что предпочтёшь выпить: лекарство зелёное, как прудовая тина, или коричневатое, цвета шелковицы?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:4.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:4.original: Come now, no need to be like that. They're so delicious, they'll send you to heaven!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:4.translation: Да ладно тебе. Они такие вкусные, что отправят тебя на небеса!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:5.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:5.original: Like, I'll die? That's what you mean, right? I know I just arrived, but I'm leaving!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:5.translation: В смысле — я умру? Ты об этом, да? Я только пришёл, но уже ухожу!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:6.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:6.original: Hold on, it won't open! What's going on here?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:7.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:7.original: Hehehe, this is my house. It stands to reason that I can lock the door from any distance!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:7.translation: Хе-хе-хе, это мой дом. Разумеется, я могу запереть дверь с любого расстояния!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:8.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:8.translation: Н-нет, это не так! Н-не подходи!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:9.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:9.original: It's alright. It won't hurt for long!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:9.translation: Всё в порядке. Больно будет недолго!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:10.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:10.original: You're really going to kill me, aren't you?! Gah, I'm cornered!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:10.translation: Ты правда собираешься меня убить?! Гах, я в углу!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:11.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:11.original: Very well. I've chosen the mulberry one for you. Here we go!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:11.translation: Хорошо. Выбрала для тебя цвет шелковицы. Поехали!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:13.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:13.original: Hey, nothing happened! In fact, I feel better than before?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:13.translation: Эй, ничего не случилось! Даже... чувствую себя лучше, чем раньше?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:14.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:14.original: Of course you do. Even I wouldn't force you to drink a harmful concoction.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:14.translation: Конечно. Даже я не стала бы пичкать тебя вредной дрянью.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:15.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:15.original: They look awful, but both are highly nutritious. You've been looking worn out recently, Mathias.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:15.translation: Выглядят ужасно, но оба очень питательные. В последнее время ты выглядишь измотанным, Матиас.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:16.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:16.original: Thank you for your concern, but was there any need to force-feed it to me?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:16.translation: Спасибо за заботу, но нужно ли было силком меня этим кормить?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:17.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:17.original: Ohohoho! For a bit of atmosphere! Just drinking it wouldn't be any fun, would it?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:17.translation: Охохохо! Для атмосферы! Просто выпить — совсем неинтересно, правда?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:18.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:18.original: She's a bit of a handful, but I guess she doesn't mean any harm.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:18.translation: С ней непросто, но, кажется, зла она не желает.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:19.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:19.original: Ah, one thing. Watch out for the aftereffects, though! The ingredients I used can sometimes make horns grow.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:19.translation: Ах, ещё кое-что. Осторожнее с побочными эффектами! Ингредиенты иногда могут отрастить рога.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:20.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:20.original: What?! I take that back! You do mean harm! You're a witch, a witch!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:20.translation: Что?! Беру свои слова назад! Ты желаешь зла! Ты ведьма, ведьма!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:21.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:21.original: Ohohoho! I'm happy being a witch! So long as I'm having fun, that's all that matters!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:21.translation: Охохохо! Я рада быть ведьмой! Главное — чтобы было весело!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:22.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:22.original: Growing up with the twins has hardened her, clearly. I'd better not grow a horn!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_070.ebm:22.translation: Жизнь с близнецами явно её закалила. Только бы рог не вырос!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:0.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:0.original: Ah, Mathias! I'm sorry about all that last time.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:0.translation: Ах, Матиас! Прости за всё в прошлый раз.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:1.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:1.original: Giving you a potion with unverified side effects? I'm so sorry, I don't know what I was thinking.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:1.translation: Дать тебе зелье с непроверенными побочными эффектами? Мне так жаль, не знаю, о чём я думала.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:2.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:2.original: L-Lucia! What's wrong? You're freaking me out!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:2.translation: Л-Люсия! Что с тобой? Ты меня пугаешь!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:3.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:3.original: Oh, how cruel! I'm sincerely trying to apologize here!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:3.translation: О, как жестоко! Я искренне пытаюсь извиниться!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:4.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:4.original: Here, I've got something to apologize. This is a real restorative, with no side effects at all!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:4.translation: Вот, у меня есть чем загладить вину. Настоящее восстанавливающее — без побочных эффектов!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:5.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:5.original: You're lying! That's a lie! It's another pointless potion of pain!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:5.translation: Ты врёшь! Это ложь! Опять бессмысленное зелье боли!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:6.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:6.original: No! Have I so undermined your trust? I suppose it can't be helped...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:6.translation: Нет! Неужели я так подорвала твоё доверие? Ничего не поделаешь...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:7.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:7.original: This is payback for all the nasty things I've done. I'm so sorry, Mathias!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:7.translation: Это расплата за все гадости, что я натворила. Мне очень жаль, Матиас!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:8.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:8.original: H-Hold on! I went too far. You brought something specially for me, Lucia. Thank you.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:8.translation: П-погоди! Я зашёл слишком далеко. Ты специально принесла это для меня, Люсия. Спасибо.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:10.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:10.original: Yes, I'll drink it. Thank you so much!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:14.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:14.original: Yes! My potion to turn people in Puni works! Now I've got Sue exactly where I want her!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:14.translation: Да! Зелье превращения в Пуни работает! Теперь Сью у меня в руках!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:15.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:15.original: You'll be back to normal tomorrow, I reckon. Goodbye, Mathias.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:15.translation: К завтрашнему дню, думаю, вернёшься в норму. Прощай, Матиас.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:16.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:16.original: Thanks for being my test subject! Sorry about all this!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:16.translation: Спасибо, что стал подопытным! Извини за всё это!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:17.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:17.original: Puni! Puni, Puni!<CR>(Ah, wait! Damn you, Lucia!)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:17.translation: Пуни! Пуни, пуни!<CR>(Ах, погоди! Будь ты проклята, Люсия!)

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:18.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:18.original: Puni! Puni, Puni!<CR>(Curse her! She's a witch! A real witch!)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:18.translation: Пуни! Пуни, пуни!<CR>(Проклятье! Она ведьма! Настоящая ведьма!)

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:19.speaker: System
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:19.original: From this Puni experience, Mathias can now use the <CLEG>Puni Mask of Justice<CLNR> costume.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_080.ebm:19.translation: Благодаря этому опыту Пуни Матиас теперь может использовать костюм <CLEG>Пуни Маска Справедливости<CLNR>.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:1.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:1.original: Hmm, wow... I see... That makes sense.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:2.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:2.original: Hey. You're distracting me. Go away.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:3.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:3.original: Come on, I'm not getting in the way. I want to learn about alchemy too!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:3.translation: Да ладно, я не мешаю. Я тоже хочу изучить алхимию!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:5.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:5.original: Think about it. Everyone adventuring with Lydie and Sue is an alchemist, aside from me!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:5.translation: Подумай. Все, кто путешествует с Лиди и Сью, — алхимики, кроме меня!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:6.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:6.original: Now that you mention it, that's true.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:7.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:7.original: It's cramping my style! Not to mention I spend every day surrounded by bombs!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:7.translation: Это портит мой стиль! Не говоря уже о том, что каждый день я окружён бомбами!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:8.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:8.original: That's why I'm here, Alt. I want you to teach me alchemy!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:8.translation: Вот почему я здесь, Альт. Хочу, чтобы ты научил меня алхимии!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:9.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:9.original: Why me? Although, I guess sometimes a miracle can happen. You never know.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:9.translation: Почему я? Хотя... иногда чудеса случаются. Мало ли.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:10.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:10.original: Very well. As a special favor to you, we'll start from the basics. First...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:10.translation: Хорошо. В виде особой услуги начнём с основ. Сначала...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:12.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:12.original: Damn it! What's wrong? It keeps going wrong, no matter how many times I try!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:12.translation: Чёрт! В чём дело? Сколько ни пробую — всё идёт наперекосяк!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:13.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:13.original: So it turns out, as expected. No miracle here. Mathias, you've got no alchemy talent at all.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:13.translation: Как и ожидалось. Никаких чудес. Матиас, у тебя вообще нет таланта к алхимии.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:14.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:14.original: Not even a glimmer of something we could work with. I mean, absolutely zero potential at all. Nothing.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:14.translation: Ни проблеска того, с чем можно работать. Абсолютный ноль. Ничего.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:15.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:15.original: Gaaah! Rub it in, why don't you!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:16.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:16.original: Basic ability plays a large part in alchemy, after all. You need to give up and do whatever it is...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:16.translation: В алхимии базовые способности многое решают. Лучше сдайся и займись чем угодно...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:17.speaker: Woman A
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:17.original: Alt! A L T, baby! We're just dropping in to see you again!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:17.translation: Альт! А-Л-Ь-Т, детка! Мы просто зашли тебя снова повидать!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:18.speaker: Woman B
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:18.original: Oh look, another hunk of man stuff! But I still prefer Alt!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:18.translation: О, смотрите, ещё один красавчик! Но я всё равно предпочитаю Альта!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:20.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:20.original: So I've got no alchemy talent at all, and he also gets all the ladies? Seriously?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:20.translation: Значит, у меня ноль таланта к алхимии, а ему ещё и все девушки? Серьёзно?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:21.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:21.original: Come on! You might not be an alchemist, but you're optimistic! You can use a sword really well!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:21.translation: Давай! Ты может и не алхимик, но ты оптимист! И мечом отлично владеешь!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:22.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:22.original: No, you're just saying that. I'm nothing. A Puni. The king of rotten Puni, that's all!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:22.translation: Нет, ты просто так говоришь. Я никто. Пуни. Король гнилых Пуни, и всё!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:23.speaker: Woman A
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:23.original: A-L-T! Baby! I've got a request for you, honey! Are you ready for my request? Do you accept it?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:23.translation: А-Л-Ь-Т! Детка! У меня к тебе просьба, милый! Готов? Принимаешь?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:24.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:24.original: Stop circling the drain and SAVE ME! Mathias!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_090.ebm:24.translation: Хватит ходить вокруг да около и СПАСИ МЕНЯ! Матиас!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:1.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:1.original: What's up? You look pretty serious. Not thinking about learning alchemy again, I hope?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:1.translation: Что случилось? Вид серьёзный. Надеюсь, снова не про алхимию?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:2.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:2.original: No. I want you to tell me how do you make women like you.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:2.translation: Нет. Хочу, чтобы ты рассказал, как тебе удаётся нравиться женщинам.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:3.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:3.original: You are so stupid, I don't know where to start!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:3.translation: Ты такой глупый, что я не знаю, с чего начать!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:4.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:4.original: Come on, help me out! I think I'm pretty handsome, right?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:4.translation: Давай, помоги! Я ведь довольно симпатичный, правда?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:5.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:5.original: So why do the women all prefer you? Why? Tell me!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:5.translation: Так почему все женщины предпочитают тебя? Почему? Скажи!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:6.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:6.original: Do I have to spell it out? It's just a matter of character.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:7.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:7.original: To be blunt, it's all your fault. You just look so dumb!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:7.translation: Грубо говоря, виноват ты сам. Ты просто выглядишь таким тупым!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:8.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:8.original: What?! You're making me mad now! Even I'll get mad at a comment like that!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:8.translation: Что?! Теперь ты меня бесишь! Даже я злюсь от такого!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:9.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:9.original: Just listen. The reason women like me is because they want a quiet, intelligent type.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:9.translation: Просто слушай. Женщинам я нравлюсь, потому что им нужен тихий, умный тип.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:11.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:11.original: If you really want to become popular... there's only one way to go. Right?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:11.translation: Если правда хочешь стать популярным... есть только один путь. Верно?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:12.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:12.original: If there's anything I can do to help, I'll do it. Let's both try our hardest, together!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:12.translation: Если чем-то могу помочь — помогу. Давай оба постараемся изо всех сил!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:13.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:13.original: Alt! Thanks so much for this! I'm going to be the talk of the town!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:13.translation: Альт! Огромное спасибо! Я стану притчей во языцех!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:14.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:14.original: That's the spirit, Mathias! Let's get started at once!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:14.translation: Вот это настрой, Матиас! Начнём сразу!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:15.original: Alt! Hello! We've got some snacks for you!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:15.translation: Альт! Привет! Мы принесли тебе угощения!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:16.original: Hey, Mathias. What are you doing in Alt's Atelier?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:16.translation: Эй, Матиас. Что ты делаешь в ателье Альта?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:17.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:17.original: Why, if it isn't Miss Lydie and Miss Sue! So lovely to see you. How are you doing?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:17.translation: О, если это не мисс Лиди и мисс Сью! Как же приятно вас видеть. Как поживаете?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:18.original: Mathias? That is you, right? You seem different from normal...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:18.translation: Матиас? Это правда ты? Ты какой-то не такой...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:19.original: What's wrong? You're actually making me feel all weird...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:19.translation: Что с тобой? Мне даже как-то жутковато...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:20.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:20.original: Weird! Haha, what a prankster you are! Come, let us sit and be friends!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:20.translation: Жутковато! Ха-ха, какая же ты шутница! Прошу, сядем и будем друзьями!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:21.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:21.original: Sue. I don't know what this all is, but I can't take it. Come on, let's go.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:21.translation: Сью. Не знаю, что это всё такое, но я не выдержу. Пойдём.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:22.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:22.original: Yeah. This creeps me out. Goodbye!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:23.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:23.original: Hey! Thanks for nothing. That didn't work at all!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:23.translation: Эй! Спасибо ни за что. Вообще не сработало!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:24.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:24.original: I noticed. Your complete lack of intellect made acting like an intellectual impossible for you.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:24.translation: Заметил. Полное отсутствие интеллекта сделало из тебя плохого актёра интеллигента.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:25.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:25.original: I was hoping you'd be able to take some of the heat off me, but I guess not...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:25.translation: Я надеялся, что ты снимешь с меня часть внимания, но, похоже, нет...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:26.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:26.original: Oh, you're going to feel heat! When I get my hands on you, you'll burn!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:26.translation: О, сейчас тебе будет жарко! Как доберусь — сгоришь!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:27.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:27.original: Hahaha! Come on, does it matter? I think you're best when you're just yourself!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:27.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Да ладно, какая разница? Лучше всего ты выглядишь, когда остаёшься собой!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:28.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:28.original: Although you'll never be popular with the ladies! Hahaha!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:28.translation: Хотя с дамами тебе никогда не повезёт! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:29.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:29.original: Alt! Damn you! Come outside and let me kick your...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_100.ebm:29.translation: Альт! Будь ты проклят! Выходи, я тебе врежу...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:0.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:0.original: Wow! The ultimate beauty! Hey, hello there!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:0.translation: Ух ты! Совершенная красота! Эй, здравствуй!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:2.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:2.original: Yes! You're incredibly beautiful! Your long and sparkling hair is like a river of stars!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:2.translation: Да! Ты невероятно красива! Твои длинные сверкающие волосы — как река звёзд!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:3.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:3.original: Oh, my! How lovely! I'm sorry, but I already have someone whom I love very much.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:3.translation: О боже! Как мило! Прости, но у меня уже есть тот, кого я очень люблю.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:4.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:4.original: You do? Then what cursed trick of fate is this! If only we had met just a little bit sooner!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:4.translation: Есть?! Что за проклятая шутка судьбы! Если бы мы встретились чуть раньше!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:5.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:5.original: Who is it, then? Tell me the name of the fiend who stole your heart!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:5.translation: Кто же это? Назови имя злодея, укравшего твоё сердце!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:8.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:8.original: Yes! She's as cute as can be! She feels so good to hug and she smells so nice!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:8.translation: Да! Она мила до невозможности! Её так приятно обнимать, и пахнет она так чудесно!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:9.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:9.original: She's so naive and innocent, but recently she's been trying to look more mature!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:9.translation: Она такая наивная и невинная, но в последнее время пытается выглядеть взрослее!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:10.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:10.original: Ah, which is even cuter, you know, I just want to protect her from the entire world!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:10.translation: Ах, и от этого ещё милее, знаешь — так и хочется защитить её от всего мира!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:11.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:11.original: Ah! Just talking about her has made me want to see her again! Firis! Firis, I'm coming!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:11.translation: Ах! От одного разговора о ней захотелось снова её увидеть! Фирис! Фирис, я иду!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:12.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:12.original: Ah, I finally understand. That's the sister of Firis who I've heard so much about.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:12.translation: Ах, теперь понял. Это та самая сестра Фирис, о которой я столько слышал.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:13.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:13.original: She's just as passionate! Like big sister, like little sister, I guess!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_110.ebm:13.translation: И такая же пылкая! Какова старшая, такова и младшая!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:1.original: Hey, Mathias. What brings you to my atelier?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:1.translation: Эй, Матиас. Что привело тебя в моё ателье?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:2.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:2.original: Not you, I'm afraid. I'm here to see Sophie.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:2.translation: Боюсь, не ты. Я здесь к Софи.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:4.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:4.original: Yes. I'd like to get to know you better. We're around the same age, too. How about we grab a lunch together?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:4.translation: Да. Хотел бы узнать тебя получше. Мы примерно одного возраста. Как насчёт вместе пообедать?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:5.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:5.original: Ah, sure. I don't mind... I think? Hahaha.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:5.translation: Ах, ладно. Не против... кажется? Ха-ха-ха.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:6.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:6.original: Mathias... You've got more courage than I thought.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:6.translation: Матиас... У тебя больше смелости, чем я думала.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:7.original: Indeed. Inviting my mentor for a meal... Did you think we would allow that?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:7.translation: Именно. Пригласить мою наставницу на трапезу... Ты думал, мы это позволим?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:8.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:8.original: Hold on. What's with the scary faces, you two?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:8.translation: Погодите. Что у вас за страшные лица?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:9.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:9.original: Sophie will take any invitation she is given. So we have to protect her.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:9.translation: Софи принимает любое приглашение. Поэтому мы должны её защищать.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:10.original: That's why, Mathias, we are declining your offer on her behalf!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:10.translation: Поэтому, Матиас, мы отклоняем твоё предложение от её имени!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:12.original: Ah, but I'll go with you! If you're offering to feed me!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:12.translation: Ах, но я с тобой пойду! Если угощаешь!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:13.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:13.original: Firis? I'm looking for someone a little older, I think?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:13.translation: Фирис? Мне, кажется, нужна кто-то чуть постарше?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:14.original: Ah! That was rude! You're in my bad books now, Mathias!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:14.translation: Ах! Как грубо! Теперь ты у меня в чёрном списке, Матиас!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:15.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:15.original: Mine too! Anyone who's mean to Firis has to answer to me!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:15.translation: И у меня! Кто обижает Фирис — отвечает передо мной!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:16.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:16.original: Ah, but taking Firis out on a date is even less allowed! Just shut up and leave!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:16.translation: Ах, а звать Фирис на свидание ещё менее позволительно! Заткнись и уходи!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:17.speaker: Mathias
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:17.original: Uwah, where'd you spring out from? I'll find no victory here! Retreat! Retreat!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:17.translation: Ува, откуда ты выскочила?! Здесь мне не победить! Отступление! Отступление!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:18.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:18.original: Ah, you scared him off! Come on, you three, I think that was a bit mean.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:18.translation: Ах, вы его спугнули! Ну же, вы трое, это было немного жестоко.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:19.speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:19.original: Not at all. It's our job to drive off anyone with designs on you, Sophie.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:19.translation: Совсем нет. Наша работа — отгонять всех, у кого на тебя виды, Софи.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:20.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:20.original: That's right! Everyone's hitting on you all the time, it's not fai... I mean, it's dangerous!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:20.translation: Верно! К тебе все постоянно пристают, это нечест... то есть опасно!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:22.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:22.original: I know you're thinking about me. Apart maybe from Liane.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:22.translation: Знаю, вы думаете обо мне. Кроме, разве что, Лианэ.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:23.speaker: Sophie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:23.original: But do I seem so untrustworthy? So insecure? So unsafe? Hmm, this is complicated.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_120.ebm:23.translation: Но неужели я кажусь такой ненадёжной? Такой неуверенной? Такой беззащитной? Хм, всё сложно.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:1.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:1.original: Indeed, Fritz. Can I help you with something?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:2.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:2.original: Heh, well, I heard you'd become human so I came to see you.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:2.translation: Хех, ну, я слышал, ты стала человеком, и пришёл взглянуть.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:3.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:3.original: It seems like just the other day, when you took on that doll body.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:3.translation: Кажется, только вчера ты обрела то кукольное тело.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:4.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:4.original: Indeed. The body you made for me was wonderful.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:4.translation: Да. Тело, которое ты сделал для меня, было чудесным.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:5.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:5.original: The reason I could become human again was because of that body. Thank you so much.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:5.translation: Именно благодаря ему я снова смогла стать человеком. Огромное спасибо.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:6.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:6.original: Hahaha, no need to thank me again. We've known each other for a long time now.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:6.translation: Ха-ха-ха, не нужно снова благодарить. Мы знакомы уже давно.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:7.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:7.original: I'm just really glad for you.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:7.translation: Я просто очень рад за тебя.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:9.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:9.original: Ah, there was another reason I came today as well.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:9.translation: Ах, сегодня я пришёл ещё и по другой причине.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:11.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:11.original: If your human body is a transformation of the doll one, I'm interested in the changes in my work.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:11.translation: Если твоё человеческое тело — превращение кукольного, мне интересно, как изменилась моя работа.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:12.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:12.original: Plachta. I would very much like to inspect your body.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:12.translation: Плахта. Я очень хотел бы осмотреть твоё тело.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:13.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:13.original: Hehe. I'm glad to see you haven't changed. Very well.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:13.translation: Хе-хе. Рада видеть, что ты не изменился. Хорошо.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:14.speaker: Plachta
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:14.original: Allow me to blow you to dust with a powerful bomb of my own making!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:14.translation: Позволь мне разнести тебя в пыль мощной бомбой собственного изготовления!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:15.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:15.original: W-Wait! I should explain myself! I only meant the joints and parts like that!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_130.ebm:15.translation: П-погоди! Позволь объяснить! Я имел в виду только суставы и тому подобное!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:0.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:0.original: I wonder if there's anything nice on sale here... Something suited to my beauty!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:0.translation: Интересно, есть ли здесь что-нибудь хорошее на продажу... Что-то, достойное моей красоты!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:3.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:3.original: I do. You are even more wonderful close up!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:4.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:4.original: I have something to ask you. Please, will you become my model?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:4.translation: У меня к вам просьба. Пожалуйста, станьте моей моделью?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:5.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:5.original: A model! Ohohohoho! You have a good eye, kind sir!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:5.translation: Моделью! Охохохохо! У вас хороший глаз, добрый сэр!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:6.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:6.original: Of course, I don't mind. Although I doubt you can capture my beauty in a painting!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:6.translation: Конечно, не против. Хотя сомневаюсь, что вы сможете передать мою красоту на картине!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:7.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:7.original: A painting? No, that's not it. I want you model for one of my dolls.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:7.translation: Картину? Нет, не то. Я хочу, чтобы вы стали моделью для одной из моих кукол.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:9.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:9.original: Yes. A doll for my doll theater. I've got the perfect role for you.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:9.translation: Да. Куклы для моего кукольного театра. У меня для вас идеальная роль.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:10.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:10.original: Very well. That sounds fine, too. Just make it as beautiful as you can!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:10.translation: Хорошо. Это тоже звучит неплохо. Только сделайте её как можно прекраснее!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:11.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:11.original: Yes, you can leave that to me! Heheh, a fine test for my skills!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:11.translation: Да, оставьте это мне! Хе-хе, отличная проверка мастерства!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:12.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:12.original: The beautiful but evil princess, who tries to trick the hero but ends up as a Puni!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:12.translation: Красивая, но злобная принцесса, что пытается обмануть героя, а в итоге становится Пуни!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:13.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:13.original: You're perfect for that villainous role! The perfect face! A miracle, to find such a model!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:13.translation: Вы идеальны для этой злодейской роли! Идеальное лицо! Чудо — найти такую модель!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:14.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:14.original: What? A villain? Evil? I'm not standing for that! Excuse me, thank you!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:14.translation: Что? Злодейку? Злую? Я этого не потерплю! Прошу прощения, всего доброго!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:15.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:15.original: No, wait! You're not escaping! You're the ultimate evil! I cannot let you get away!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_140.ebm:15.translation: Нет, стойте! Вам не уйти! Вы — воплощение зла! Я не могу вас отпустить!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:1.original: Ah! Lucia, welcome. What can I help you with today?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:1.translation: Ах! Люсия, добро пожаловать. Чем могу помочь сегодня?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:2.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:2.original: Well, I can't say this too loudly, but I want you to teach me some alchemy.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:2.translation: Ну, громко говорить не буду, но хочу, чтобы ты научила меня алхимии.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:3.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:3.original: I hate to admit it, but you're better than me. I'd very much like to learn from you.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:3.translation: Ненавижу признавать, но ты лучше меня. Очень хотела бы у тебя поучиться.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:4.original: Sure, no problem. I'm not sure what I can teach you, though...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:4.translation: Конечно, без проблем. Хотя не уверена, чему именно смогу научить...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:5.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:5.original: I was just about to do some synthesis, so maybe watch me do that?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:5.translation: Я как раз собиралась синтезировать — может, просто посмотришь?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:6.original: First, you throw in the materials with a splash!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:7.original: Next turn up the temp of the cauldron, see it roar! Then mix it up, mix mix mix!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:7.translation: Потом поднимаешь жар котла — пусть ревёт! Потом мешай, мешай, мешай!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:8.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:8.original: Splash? Roar? Mix mix mix? Are you joking?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:9.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:9.original: Then wait for it to cool down, and we're done!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:9.translation: Потом ждёшь, пока остынет — и готово!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:10.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:10.original: Hold on, you're finished already? And it's absolutely incredible!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:10.translation: Погоди, ты уже закончила? И результат просто невероятный!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:11.original: Hahaha, this is how I synthesize. Did you learn anything?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:11.translation: Ха-ха-ха, вот так я и синтезирую. Чему-нибудь научилась?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:12.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:12.original: Nope, not at all! I didn't have a clue what you were doing!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:12.translation: Нет, ничему! Я вообще ничего не поняла!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:13.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:13.original: What? I'm sorry! I know how to do it but I'm not good at teaching it.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:13.translation: Что? Прости! Я умею делать, но плохо умею объяснять.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:14.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:14.original: I think I need to stop relying on others and just master my own alchemy, don't I?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_150.ebm:14.translation: Пожалуй, пора перестать полагаться на других и просто освоить собственную алхимию?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:1.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:1.original: W-What did you just say? How rude! You'd dare call me a pervert?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:1.translation: Ч-что ты только что сказал? Как грубо! Посмел назвать меня извращенцем?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:2.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:2.original: Sorry about that. Force of habit...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:3.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:3.original: A habit? Just who are you?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:4.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:4.original: Gah, this could get annoying. I'll need to get through this...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:4.translation: Гах, может быть неприятно. Нужно как-то выкрутиться...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:5.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:5.original: Oh! So sorry! Sorry! I from other kingdom! Far far kingdom!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:5.translation: О! Очень извинять! Извинять! Я из другого королевства! Дальнее-дальнее королевство!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:6.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:6.original: In home kingdom, "pervert" is great compliment, it is. Like, "how wonderful you are looking"!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:6.translation: В родном королевстве «извращенец» — большой комплимент! Вроде «как чудесно вы выглядеть»!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:7.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:7.original: W-Where did that crazy accent come from? Still, I guess if this is just a misunderstanding...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:7.translation: О-откуда этот безумный акцент? Впрочем, если это просто недоразумение...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:8.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:8.original: Miss very understanding, yes, very! Hahaha! Bye-bye, you old pervert!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:8.translation: Мисс очень понимающий, да, очень! Ха-ха-ха! Пока-пока, старый извращенец!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:9.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:9.original: Hey! He said "old pervert" at the end there! Who was that weird kid?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:9.translation: Эй! В конце он сказал «старый извращенец»! Кто был этот странный мальчишка?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:10.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:10.original: It feels like I've met him before somewhere...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:10.translation: Кажется, я его где-то уже встречал...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:11.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:11.original: Phew, looks like I made it through. Man, why are so many familiar faces showing up in this city?!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:11.translation: Уф, похоже, пронесло. Блин, почему в этом городе столько знакомых лиц?!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:12.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:12.original: And I came all the way here to avoid this kind of thing... Fate playing tricks again!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_160.ebm:12.translation: А я ведь приехал сюда как раз, чтобы такого избегать... Судьба снова шутит!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:0.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:0.original: Gah! Pervert! Damn, another old reflex!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:0.translation: Гах! Извращенец! Чёрт, опять старый рефлекс!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:1.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:1.original: Ah, the pervert caller! Great timing.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:2.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:2.original: I've been waiting to see you again. Care to grab some tea with me?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:2.translation: Я как раз ждал встречи. Не выпьешь со мной чаю?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:3.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:3.original: So sorry, so sorry! I very busy! Busy like working bee!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:3.translation: Очень извинять, очень извинять! Я очень занят! Занят как рабочая пчела!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:4.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:4.original: Hey, no need to be like that. We go way back, right, Luard?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:4.translation: Эй, не надо так. Мы же давно знакомы, правда, Луард?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:6.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:6.original: How did you know I was Luard? Did Sophie tell you?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:6.translation: Откуда ты знаешь, что я Луард? Софи сказала?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:7.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:7.original: Nope. She's never a one to share information like that about others.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:7.translation: Нет. Она никогда не болтает о чужих секретах.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:8.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:8.original: It was the way you said "pervert"... That look in your eyes, the venom on your lips...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:8.translation: Это то, как ты сказал «извращенец»... Этот взгляд, яд на губах...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:9.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:9.original: I've been called all sorts of things in my life, but only Atomina could spike my heart like that.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:9.translation: Меня в жизни звали всяко, но только Атомина могла так кольнуть в самое сердце.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:10.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:10.original: You're just making my case for me, I think...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:10.translation: Ты только подтверждаешь мои слова, мне кажется...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:11.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:11.original: Hahaha! Call it the hunch of an old man. You've changed though, haven't you?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:11.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Назовём это чутьём старика. Но ты изменился, правда?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:12.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:12.original: You think? I still strive to be an alchemist of evil.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:12.translation: Думаешь? Я по-прежнему стремлюсь стать алхимиком зла.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:13.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:13.original: True evil doesn't call itself evil. Right now, you look full of hope to me.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:13.translation: Настоящее зло не называет себя злом. Сейчас ты для меня полон надежды.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:14.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:14.original: Don't get too full of yourself, "old" man. I've still got many more years on you!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:14.translation: Не зазнавайся, «старик». У меня всё ещё на много лет больше, чем у тебя!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:15.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:15.original: Not at the moment you don't. Not from the look of you, Luard... or should I say Alt?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:15.translation: Сейчас — нет. Не по твоему виду, Луард... или сказать Альт?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:16.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:16.original: You just stay on the straight and narrow from now on. You understand?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:16.translation: Просто держись правильного пути отныне. Понял?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:17.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:17.original: I'll do my best. See you around, you old pervert.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:18.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:18.original: You too, kid from a far far land. Take care.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_170.ebm:18.translation: И ты, мальчишка из дальнего-дальнего края. Береги себя.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:0.speaker: Roger
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:0.original: Hmm, I want a little more realism there.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:0.translation: Хм, хочу чуть больше реализма здесь.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:2.original: I'm back, Dad! Sue went to buy a comic...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:2.translation: Я вернулась, папа! Сью пошла купить комикс...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:4.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:4.original: Sorry, I just stopped by. Hmmm.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:5.original: What's up? Why are you staring at dad like that?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:5.translation: Что такое? Почему ты так смотришь на папу?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:6.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:6.original: No, I was just thinking. Uncle's getting old, isn't he?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:6.translation: Нет, я просто думала. Дядя стареет, правда?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
