ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:7.original: Hahaha, well, look at how much we've grown up! Time doesn't stand still for anyone.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:7.translation: Ха-ха-ха, ну посмотри, как мы выросли! Время ни для кого не стоит на месте.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:8.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:8.original: You're right, of course. He was so cool when he was younger, though!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:8.translation: Конечно, ты права. Но в молодости он был таким крутым!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:9.original: Of course! You've always had a bit of a thing for our dad, haven't you?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:9.translation: Конечно! У тебя всегда была слабость к нашему папе, правда?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:10.original: You even said you'd marry him once you grew up!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:10.translation: Ты даже говорила, что выйдешь за него, когда вырастешь!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:11.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:11.original: I was little kid, alright?! But I admit, for some reason, being around him has always calmed me...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:11.translation: Я была маленькой, ясно?! Но признаю — рядом с ним мне почему-то всегда спокойно...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:12.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:12.original: The complete opposite of my dad, even though they are brothers. So warm, scatterbrained, chaotic...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:12.translation: Полная противоположность моему отцу, хотя они братья. Такой тёплый, рассеянный, хаотичный...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:13.speaker: Roger
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:13.original: Hey, Lucia. You're not badmouthing me, are you?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:13.translation: Эй, Люсия. Ты меня не поливаешь грязью?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:14.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:14.original: Not at all. I think you were my first love.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:14.translation: Совсем нет. Думаю, ты был моей первой любовью.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:15.original: Hahaha! Lucia, you definitely need to get some glasses!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:15.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Люсия, тебе определённо нужны очки!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:16.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:16.original: I know! I was just thinking the same thing!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:16.translation: Знаю! Я как раз о том же думала!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:17.speaker: Roger
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:17.original: Girls! I'm here, just minding my business, painting away, and here you two come...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:17.translation: Девочки! Я тут спокойно себе рисую, а вы двое...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:18.original: Uwah, we've made him mad! I'm sorry!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:19.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:19.original: So very sorry! I think I'd better get going, anyway.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:19.translation: Очень прошу прощения! Пожалуй, мне лучше идти.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:20.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:20.original: Lydie. Look after him for us all, will you?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:20.translation: Лиди. Присмотри за ним за всех нас, ладно?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:21.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:21.original: Yes, I will. He's still my dear old dad, warts and all.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:21.translation: Да, присмотрю. Он всё равно мой дорогой старый папа — со всеми недостатками.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:22.speaker: Roger
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:22.original: What are you... Just what are you two...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:23.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:23.original: Hehe, see you later! You've got many more years of painting left, I'm sure!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_180.ebm:23.translation: Хе-хе, увидимся! Уверена, впереди у тебя ещё много лет рисования!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:1.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:1.original: Hehehe, eat up, eat up! Ah, Ilmeria.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:2.original: Mireille. I've got some questions about that Puni.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:2.translation: Мирей. У меня есть вопросы об этом Пуни.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:4.original: I've seen it before. Just where did you find it?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:4.translation: Я видела его раньше. Где ты его нашла?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:5.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:5.original: I didn't find it, I was given it. By the mayor of a town called Reisenberg.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:5.translation: Не нашла — мне его подарили. Мэр города под названием Райзенберг.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:6.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:6.original: From Edel? So that's the Puni from the certification exam!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:6.translation: От Эдель? Значит, это Пуни с экзамена на сертификат!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:7.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:7.original: That's right! I love to think of all the certified alchemists who know this Puni!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:7.translation: Верно! Люблю думать обо всех сертифицированных алхимиках, которые знают этого Пуни!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:8.original: Well, "know" might be a stretch... My recollection is more like "used as a target"...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:8.translation: Ну, «знают» — громко сказано... Мои воспоминания скорее «использовали как мишень»...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:10.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:10.original: I see. Glad you found a place for yourself, anyway.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:10.translation: Понятно. В любом случае, рада, что ты нашёл своё место.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:12.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:12.original: You've got a new job now, right? A cute one carrying letters around on your head.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:12.translation: У тебя теперь новая работа, верно? Милая — носить письма на голове.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:13.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:13.original: I'm sorry for throwing those bombs at you during my exam. Keep up the good work!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:13.translation: Прости, что кидала в тебя бомбы на экзамене. Так держать!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:15.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:15.original: Look at the praise being heaped on you today, Puni Saemon! I've got some more work for you, too.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:15.translation: Смотри, сколько сегодня похвал, Пуни Саэмон! У меня для тебя тоже есть работа.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:16.speaker: Mireille
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:16.original: You've got three mountains to cross to deliver this, and I need it done by tomorrow!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:16.translation: Тебе нужно пересечь три горы, чтобы доставить это, и к завтрашнему дню!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:18.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:18.original: Hahaha! Looks like it's still in a harsh work environment. I'm supporting you, Puni Saemon!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_190.ebm:18.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Похоже, условия труда по-прежнему суровые. Я за тебя, Пуни Саэмон!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:2.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:2.original: What are you doing today? Some shopping? Buying some things, right?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:2.translation: Чем сегодня занята? Шопинг? Покупки, да?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:3.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:3.original: Hahaha, nope! I did loads of shopping from you back in Reisenberg!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:3.translation: Ха-ха-ха, нет! Я ещё в Райзенберге накупила у тебя кучу всего!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:4.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:4.original: Sure, but it still isn't enough! I want you to buy more, more of everything!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:4.translation: Конечно, но этого всё равно мало! Хочу, чтобы ты покупала ещё, ещё и ещё!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:5.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:5.original: Fine, fine, we'll come back to that in a moment. I've got something to ask you first.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:5.translation: Ладно-ладно, к этому вернёмся. Сначала у меня вопрос.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:6.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:6.original: It's about my mom. Is she always like that, when she's in the church?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:6.translation: Про мою маму. Она всегда такая, когда в церкви?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:7.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:7.original: By "like that", I presume you mean...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:8.speaker: Grace
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:8.original: Ines. Calm down when praying, my child. You want your prayers to reach God's ears, don't you?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:8.translation: Инес. Успокойся на молитве, дитя моё. Хочешь, чтобы молитвы дошли до ушей Бога, верно?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:10.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:10.original: Yes, I think she is. That's all I've seen from her.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:10.translation: Да, думаю, да. Я видела от неё только такое.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:11.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:11.original: I see. Mom used to be a bit more lively than that, that's all.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:11.translation: Понятно. Просто раньше мама была чуть живее.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:13.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:13.original: Oh. I'll try and show you.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:14.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:14.original: Boys and girls! Welcome to Grace's puppet theater! You're all going to have loads of fun today!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:14.translation: Мальчики и девочки! Добро пожаловать в кукольный театр Грейс! Сегодня вам будет очень весело!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:15.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:15.original: So settle down and prepare to shout your little heads off! Sparky-sparkles! Ahem. Like that.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:15.translation: Так что устройтесь и приготовьтесь орать во всю мощь! Искорки-блёстки! Кхм. Вот так.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:16.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:16.original: Ah, hold on... She did something like that when we did a puppet show the other day.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:16.translation: Ах, погоди... Она что-то такое делала, когда мы ставили кукольный спектакль на днях.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:17.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:17.original: She did? So this solemn mom is all just an act!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:17.translation: Правда? Значит, эта торжественная мама — сплошной спектакль!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:18.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:18.original: Yes, you might be right. It sounds like Grace has quite a checkered past, too.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:18.translation: Да, возможно. Похоже, у Грейс весьма пёстрое прошлое.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:19.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:19.original: I think I'll ask her about it! I can't wait to see what she says!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_200.ebm:19.translation: Думаю, спрошу её об этом! Уже не терпится услышать, что она скажет!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:0.original: That's the stuff! Mom's pancakes are always the best!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:0.translation: Вот это да! Мамины блины всегда лучшие!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:1.original: I know! I can't stop stuffing them down! Ah, I'm so happy!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:1.translation: Знаю! Не могу остановиться! Ах, как же счастлива!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:2.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:2.original: I'm glad you enjoyed them. Now, after eating, you know what comes next?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:2.translation: Рада, что вам понравилось. А теперь, после еды, знаете, что дальше?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:3.original: Yes! We tidy the plates away! Come on, Sue!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:6.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:6.original: I thought you might like to talk for a while. Look how lovely you are, Lucia!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:6.translation: Подумала, ты не против немного поговорить. Какая ты милая, Люсия!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:8.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:8.original: You look so grown up now. And your hair is so lovely!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:8.translation: Ты так выросла. И волосы такие прекрасные!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:9.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:9.original: It looks like you've been taking care of it just like I showed you.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:9.translation: Похоже, ты ухаживаешь за ними так, как я показывала.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:10.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:10.original: Yes, I have. I want to be just like you, after all!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:10.translation: Да. Я ведь хочу быть совсем как ты!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:11.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:11.original: So beautiful, and so kind! You always taught me so many things.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:11.translation: Такая красивая и такая добрая! Ты всегда столькому меня учила.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:12.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:12.original: When you died, I was so sad! So very sad!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:12.translation: Когда ты умерла, мне было так грустно! Очень-очень грустно!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:13.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:13.original: Hehe, you're still a bit of a crybaby too, I see. No need to smear that cute face with tears.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:13.translation: Хе-хе, всё ещё немного плакса, вижу. Не надо пачкать это милое личико слезами.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:14.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:14.original: Thank you, though. You've been keeping an eye on my two girls for me too, haven't you?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:14.translation: Но спасибо. Ты и за моими двумя девочками присматривала, правда?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:17.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:17.original: Lydie and Suelle have grown up so straight and true thanks in part to you, Lucia.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:17.translation: Лидия и Сюэль выросли такими честными и правильными отчасти благодаря тебе, Люсия.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:18.speaker: Honnete
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:18.original: Lucia. Please just keep on doing what you've been doing.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:18.translation: Люсия. Пожалуйста, просто продолжай делать то, что делала.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:19.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:19.original: Hehe. I can't turn down a request from you.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:19.translation: Хе-хе. Не могу отказать тебе в просьбе.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:20.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:20.original: They have no respect for their elders, I assure you, but I'll do what I can to keep them in line.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:20.translation: Уважения к старшим у них ни на грош, уверяю, но я сделаю всё, чтобы держать их в узде.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:21.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_210.ebm:21.original: There's no need to worry, auntie.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:0.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:0.original: It doesn't matter how many times you ask! I'm not going to budge!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:1.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:1.original: Please, Fritz! I know we can work out something!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:1.translation: Пожалуйста, Фриц! Уверена, мы можем договориться!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:2.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:2.original: Without her, I don't think I'll be able to live!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:2.translation: Без неё, мне кажется, я не смогу жить!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:3.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:3.original: Now you're just getting carried away. It's not like this is a matter of life or death!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:3.translation: Ты уже заходишь слишком далеко. Это же не вопрос жизни и смерти!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:4.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:4.original: Oh, but it is! My life would be completely different!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:4.translation: О, ещё какая! Моя жизнь была бы совсем другой!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:6.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:6.original: The life-sized Firis you use in your puppet show! Please, give her to me!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:6.translation: Та полноразмерная Фирис из твоего кукольного спектакля! Пожалуйста, отдай её мне!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:7.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:7.original: No! She's an important part of the show. I can't give her to anyone, even you!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:7.translation: Нет! Она важная часть представления. Не могу отдать её никому, даже тебе!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:9.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:9.original: Phew, have you finally given up? You are normally so calm and collected, honestly...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:9.translation: Уф, наконец сдалась? Обычно ты такая спокойная и собранная, честно...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:11.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:11.original: Uwah! Where did you get so much money?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:11.translation: Ува! Откуда у тебя столько денег?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:12.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:12.original: I do run a shop. Firis won't take my charity, so it just piles up!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:12.translation: У меня же магазин. Фирис не берёт мою благотворительность, так что они просто копятся!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:13.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:13.original: Pile away! No matter what you offer, I'm not going to sell...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:13.translation: Копи сколько угодно! Что бы ты ни предложила — я не продам...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:14.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:14.original: I'm not asking you to sell her. I'm asking you to make me a new one!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:14.translation: Я не прошу продать. Я прошу сделать мне новую!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:15.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:15.original: This is more than enough money, surely? Or would you turn down a paying customer, Fritz?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:15.translation: Этих денег более чем достаточно, правда? Или ты откажешь платящему клиенту, Фриц?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:16.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:16.original: Hahahaha! I give up. I can't beat you, clearly.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:16.translation: Ха-ха-ха-ха! Сдаюсь. Тебя явно не победить.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:17.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:17.original: Very well. I'll use this money to make you the ultimate life-sized Firis!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:17.translation: Хорошо. На эти деньги сделаю тебе идеальную полноразмерную Фирис!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:19.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:19.original: Boy, she hasn't changed a bit, either. Firis is lucky to have someone who cares for her so much.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:19.translation: Боже, и она ничуть не изменилась. Фирис повезло с тем, кто так о ней заботится.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:20.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:20.original: Even if she does take things a bit far...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_220.ebm:20.translation: Даже если она заходит чуть далековато...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:0.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:0.original: There's something suspicious about you, Alt, isn't there?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:0.translation: В тебе есть что-то подозрительное, Альт, правда?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:1.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:1.original: You just suddenly turn up at my atelier and say that? Are you picking a fight?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:1.translation: Ты просто так заходишь в моё ателье и говоришь это? Ищешь ссоры?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:2.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:2.original: No, not at all. I'm just stating a fact.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:2.translation: Нет, вовсе нет. Просто констатирую факт.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:3.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:3.original: From your toes to the top of your head... You couldn't be more suspicious looking!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:3.translation: От носков до макушки... Ты не мог бы выглядеть подозрительнее!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:4.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:4.original: Hahaha, I've been called suspicious before, but never quite so completely!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:4.translation: Ха-ха-ха, меня и раньше называли подозрительным, но никогда настолько всесторонне!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:5.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:5.original: What's your plan, then? Are you going to call in the guards on me?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:5.translation: И каков план? Вызовешь на меня стражу?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:8.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:8.original: Collude. As in, collusion. The darkness I see in your heart makes you my ideal business partner.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:8.translation: Сговориться. То есть сговор. Тьма, что я вижу в твоём сердце, делает тебя идеальным деловым партнёром.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:9.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:9.original: You've got alchemy skills, too. How about it? Join me in aiming for the top?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:9.translation: И алхимией ты владеешь. Как насчёт? Вместе метить в вершину?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:10.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:10.original: Hahahaha! No thanks. You're too green to be my partner.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:10.translation: Ха-ха-ха-ха! Нет, спасибо. Ты слишком зелёная для моего партнёра.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:12.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:12.original: Not to mention you've got "lie" written all over your face. You need to start by fooling yourself!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:12.translation: Не говоря уже о том, что на лице у тебя написано «ложь». Сначала научись обманывать себя!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:13.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:13.original: You're trying to keep an eye on me, then, to protect your precious twins?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:13.translation: Значит, пытаешься присмотреть за мной, чтобы защитить своих драгоценных близнецов?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:14.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:14.original: How naive of you, naive indeed... Did you think I'd fall for that?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:14.translation: Как наивно, очень наивно... Думала, я на это куплюсь?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:15.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:15.original: Gah! I'll leave you be, for today!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:15.translation: Гах! На сегодня оставлю тебя в покое!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:16.speaker: Lucia
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:16.original: Just remember this! If you do anything nasty to them, I'll never forgive you!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:16.translation: Только запомни! Если сделаешь им что-то гадкое — никогда не прощу!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:17.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:17.original: She's smart, sure, but also a bit of a soft touch.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:17.translation: Умна, конечно, но и мягкотелая немного.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:18.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:18.original: Which I guess is okay, for an alchemist. I'll look forward to her future as well, then.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_230.ebm:18.translation: Что, впрочем, нормально для алхимика. Тогда и её будущее тоже буду ждать с интересом.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:0.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:0.original: The sea... I've never really had much experience with the sea before.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:0.translation: Море... У меня почти не было опыта с морем.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:1.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:1.original: Oh, really? The sea is lovely! So large, so beautiful!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:1.translation: О, правда? Море прекрасное! Такое большое, такое красивое!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:2.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:2.original: Uwaaah! Where did you come from?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:3.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:3.original: Hehehe, I saw you looking over the ocean so I thought I'd surprise you a little. Hold on?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:3.translation: Хе-хе-хе, увидела, как ты смотришь на океан, и решила немного удивить. Погоди?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:4.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:4.original: It feels like we've met somewhere before? Have we?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:5.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:5.original: No, I don't think so. Sounds like you're imagining things?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:5.translation: Нет, не думаю. Тебе, похоже, мерещится?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:6.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:6.original: Do you think so? You always had someone else with you, didn't you?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:6.translation: Думаешь? С тобой всегда был кто-то ещё, правда?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:7.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:7.original: Is your younger brother well? Or was she a sister?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:7.translation: Как поживает младший брат? Или это была сестра?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:8.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:8.original: This is odd. Which one was it, again?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:9.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:9.original: D-Don't tell me! Even in my transformed state, you know who I am?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:9.translation: Н-не может быть! Даже в изменённом облике ты знаешь, кто я?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:10.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:10.original: Hehehe! You were both so clingy. So cute!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:10.translation: Хе-хе-хе! Вы оба были такими прилипчивыми. Такие милые!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:11.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:11.original: That hasn't changed, has it? If you need anything from me, you only have to ask.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:11.translation: Это не изменилось, правда? Если что-то нужно от меня — стоит только попросить.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:12.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:12.original: Gah! I must resist! I must not bend to this alluring magic!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:12.translation: Гах! Нужно сопротивляться! Нельзя поддаваться этой чарующей магии!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:13.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:13.original: I'm an adult, over five hundred years old! I can't succumb to this!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:13.translation: Мне больше пятисот лет, я взрослый! Я не могу поддаться!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:14.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:14.original: And yet I can't stop trembling! All of my cells, my very being, wants to accept her offer!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:14.translation: И всё же не могу перестать дрожать! Все клетки, всё моё существо хочет принять её предложение!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:17.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:17.original: Uwah, Pamela! It's been so hard! So difficult on me!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:17.translation: Ува, Памела! Было так тяжело! Так трудно!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:18.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:18.original: Okay, okay, good boy. You've done so well.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_240.ebm:18.translation: Ладно-ладно, хороший мальчик. Ты так старался.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:0.original: Drossel, could you recommend a good book?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:1.original: Firis told me that you're a real book lover.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:1.translation: Фирис говорила, что ты настоящая книголюбка.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:2.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:2.original: Sure thing! A recent recommendation would be "Den of Dolls".

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:4.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:4.original: Huh? Oh, then... How can I resist that smile?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:4.translation: А? О, тогда... Как устоять перед этой улыбкой?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:5.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:5.original: First, then, "False Dreams". A girl travels her dreams with some surprising twists.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:5.translation: Для начала — «Ложные сны». Девочка путешествует по своим снам, с неожиданными поворотами.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:7.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:7.original: Also, "Mist Talker". It's a tale of horror, so don't read it at night.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:7.translation: Ещё «Говорящий туман». История ужасов — не читай ночью.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:8.original: "Mist Talker". Watch out for reading at night. Good, good.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:8.translation: «Говорящий туман». Осторожно с чтением ночью. Хорошо, хорошо.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:9.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:9.original: Ah, I can't forget "Sky Dancer," either! Romance, this one will make you cry!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:9.translation: Ах, и «Небесная танцовщица»! Романтика — от этой прослезишься!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:10.original: "Sky Dancer". Have a handkerchief ready. Good, good!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:11.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:11.original: Hehe, it makes me happy to see you noting down all my recommendations.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:11.translation: Хе-хе, приятно видеть, как ты записываешь все мои рекомендации.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:12.original: It does? That's just me, I have to note things down or I can't be sure.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:12.translation: Правда? Это просто я — если не запишу, не буду уверена.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:13.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:13.original: You've got a serious streak, Lydie. It's far better than forgetting everything, anyway!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:13.translation: У тебя серьёзная жилка, Лиди. В любом случае лучше, чем всё забывать!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:14.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:14.original: Those are my best three at the moment, anyway. I'm sure you'll enjoy all of them.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:14.translation: В любом случае, это моя лучшая тройка на данный момент. Уверена, тебе все три понравятся.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:15.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:15.original: None of them are that expensive, so please give them a try!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:15.translation: Ни одна не слишком дорогая — пожалуйста, попробуй!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:18.original: Gah, I fell asleep standing up again! Lydie, are you done yet?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:18.translation: Гах, опять заснула стоя! Лиди, ты уже закончила?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:19.speaker: Drossel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:19.original: And Sue has no interest in books at all. Looks like she has her own talents, though!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_250.ebm:19.translation: А Сью книгами совсем не интересуется. Зато, похоже, у неё свои таланты!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:1.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:1.original: Oh, my! Hehe, you just want it all, don't you Ilmeria!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:1.translation: О боже! Хе-хе, тебе всегда всего мало, правда, Ильмерия!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:2.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:2.original: Is that the same, now that you're grown up? Go ahead! Take as much as you want!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:2.translation: И сейчас, когда выросла, то же самое? Бери! Бери сколько хочешь!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:3.original: Yes! Your sweets are the best, Liane. I could never forget this sugar rush!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:3.translation: Да! Твои сладости лучшие, Лианэ. Я никогда не забуду этот сахарный удар!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:4.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:4.original: Ah, I'm so happy to hear that. You always used to eat so many, didn't you!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:4.translation: Ах, так приятно слышать. Ты всегда так много ела, правда!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:5.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:5.original: I've got some new ones for you too, made using the sweetest fruit!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:5.translation: И новые для тебя есть — из самых сладких фруктов!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:6.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:6.original: Uwah! These look delicious! I can't wait to try one!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:6.translation: Ува! Выглядят вкусно! Не терпится попробовать!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:7.speaker: Liane
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:7.original: Go right ahead. Ah, you're so cute too! It's like having another sister!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_260.ebm:7.translation: Угощайся. Ах, и ты тоже такая милая! Как будто ещё одна сестра!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:0.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:0.original: Grace! Grace, are you here? I've got a present for you.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:0.translation: Грейс! Грейс, ты здесь? У меня для тебя подарок.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:1.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:1.original: Ah, if it isn't Fritz. I'm sorry, Grace isn't here right now.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:1.translation: Ах, это же Фриц. Прости, Грейс сейчас нет.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:2.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:2.original: Ah, I see. I bought some new clothes, and I just wanted to show them to her.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:2.translation: Ах, понятно. Купил новую одежду и просто хотел ей показать.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:3.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:3.original: Oh, some clothing? Show me, show me!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:4.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:4.original: Sure. Say, Pamela, do you remember Leon? From back in Kirchen Bell?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:4.translation: Конечно. Скажи, Памела, ты помнишь Леон? Из Кирхенбелла?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:5.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:5.original: I saw some of her clothes at the shop, and just couldn't help myself.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:5.translation: Увидел в магазине её одежду — и просто не смог удержаться.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:6.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:6.original: Oh, Leon's work? Of course I remember her!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:7.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:7.original: She's a real big deal now. Got loads of students too, so I hear!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:7.translation: Она теперь большая шишка. И учеников куча, говорят!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:8.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:8.original: Really? I didn't know that! So she's doing well too, is she? Good to know.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:8.translation: Правда? Не знал! Значит, у неё тоже всё хорошо? Приятно слышать.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:9.speaker: Fritz
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:9.original: If I bump into her again, I'll be sure to take her out for a drink.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:9.translation: Если снова столкнусь — обязательно приглашу выпить.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:10.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:10.original: Hehehe, I'm sure you'll see her again one day. I just have that feeling.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:10.translation: Хе-хе-хе, уверена, однажды ты её снова увидишь. У меня просто такое чувство.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:11.speaker: Pamela
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:11.original: I'll join you, when that time comes. We can chat about Sophie over some drinks!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_270.ebm:11.translation: И я присоединюсь, когда придёт время. Поболтаем о Софи за бокалом!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:1.original: Enough! Alt, that's enough of that! You're completely freaking me out!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:1.translation: Хватит! Альт, хватит! Ты меня полностью пугаешь!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:2.original: Uwah! I'm trembling over here. That's the stuff of nightmares! What about Termina, anyway?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:2.translation: Ува! Я вся дрожу. Это кошмар какой-то! А что насчёт Термины?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:3.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:3.original: When I met her, I admit I got a bit excited. I've wanted that power for a long time, after all.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:3.translation: Когда встретил её, признаюсь, немного возбудился. Эту силу я давно хотел, в конце концов.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:4.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:4.original: A goddess who destroys all! Isn't that wonderful? I really wanted to investigate her abilities!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:4.translation: Богиня, уничтожающая всё! Разве не чудесно? Так хотел изучить её способности!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:5.original: Please, enough. Termina is just a regular girl.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:5.translation: Пожалуйста, хватит. Термина — просто обычная девочка.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:6.original: Regular, sure, but also incredibly strong. Mess with her and she'll mess with you back.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:6.translation: Обычная, да, но и невероятно сильная. Свяжешься с ней — ответит тем же.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:7.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:7.original: Yeah, I know. That's why I'm keeping it all in the realm of imagination, for now.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:7.translation: Да, знаю. Поэтому пока держу всё в рамках воображения.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:8.original: Sitting around "imagining" about a girl? Alt, you've got a dirtier mind than I thought!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:8.translation: Сидишь и «воображаешь» девушку? Альт, ум у тебя грязнее, чем я думала!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:9.original: Let's get out of here, Sue. We might get infected by whatever he's got if we stay.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:9.translation: Уходим, Сью. Если останемся, можем чем-нибудь от него заразиться.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:10.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:10.original: You're kidding! Listen to me, Lydie!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:11.original: No. I don't listen to perverts!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:12.original: Hahaha, I think you need to watch what you say around Lydie... That's all.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:12.translation: Ха-ха-ха, думаю, тебе стоит следить за словами рядом с Лиди... Вот и всё.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:13.speaker: Alt
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:13.original: I was thinking purely about alchemy applications. I'll have to go and apologize later.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_280.ebm:13.translation: Я думал чисто о применении в алхимии. Придётся потом извиниться.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:0.original: Gyaaaah! A bug! Get it off me! Get it out!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:1.original: That's hardly a bug! It's tiny. Come on, then, hold still.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:1.translation: Это едва ли жук! Крошечный. Ну же, не дёргайся.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:2.original: There you are! Free to go!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:3.original: Phew, it's gone. Talk about an invader! A criminal in the house!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:3.translation: Уф, ушёл. Вот это захватчик! Преступник в доме!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:4.original: Hahaha. You really do hate bugs, don't you Sue?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:4.translation: Ха-ха-ха. Ты и правда ненавидишь жуков, Сью?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:5.original: When did that start, though? When you were a kid I remember you holding them with no fuss...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:5.translation: А с чего это началось? В детстве, помню, ты спокойно их держала...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:6.original: You want to know? Do you? Well, it was when I was seven...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:6.translation: Хочешь знать? Правда? Ну, это было, когда мне было семь...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:7.original: Ah, you're just going to tell the story?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:7.translation: Ах, ты просто собираешься рассказать историю?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:8.original: I got up to some real nasty mischief, and so mom put me on a time out in the store shed.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:8.translation: Я здорово напроказничала, и мама отправила меня на наказание в сарай.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:9.original: She even warned me about the ghosts in there! I was tearing up before she even closed the door!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:9.translation: Ещё и предупредила про призраков там! Я уже ревела, ещё до того как дверь закрылась!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:10.original: Then, in the dark, I started hearing scratching. It was like they were crawling all over me!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:10.translation: Потом в темноте заскрежетало. Как будто они ползали по мне!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:11.original: Uwah. I remember that. You were screaming your head off!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:11.translation: Ува. Помню. Ты орала во всю глотку!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:12.original: That's right! I couldn't do anything else! If I moved I thought I'd start crushing them!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:12.translation: Точно! Я ничего не могла сделать! Думала, если пошевелюсь — раздавлю их!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:13.original: That's when I started to hate bugs. Just thinking about them gives me goosebumps...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:13.translation: С тех пор и ненавижу жуков. От одной мысли — мурашки...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:14.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:14.original: I see. You've earned some sympathy from me, then.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:14.translation: Понятно. Тогда ты заслужила моё сочувствие.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:15.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:15.original: Glad to hear it! Mom could be pretty strict, couldn't she? I was just playing around!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:15.translation: Приятно слышать! Мама могла быть довольно строгой, правда? А я просто баловалась!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:16.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:16.original: Yes? And what exactly did you do?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:16.translation: Да? А что именно ты сделала?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:17.original: I filled all the bottles in the kitchen with Puni! As many as I could! So blue and sparkly.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:17.translation: Набила все бутылки на кухне Пуни! Сколько смогла! Такие синие и блестящие.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:18.original: So much for sympathy. That would upset anyone... Which means your bug phobia is your own fault!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:18.translation: Сочувствие закончилось. Это кого угодно выведет... Значит, фобия жуков — твоя вина!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:19.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:19.original: If a bug comes close to you again, I'm not going to sweep it away!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:19.translation: Если жук снова подойдёт — я его не уберу!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:20.original: Aaaah, no, that's mean! Please, help me!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:20.translation: Аааа, нет, это жестоко! Пожалуйста, помоги!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:21.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:21.original: I won't survive without you, Lydie! Lydie! Please, Lydie! Sis, come on!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_290.ebm:21.translation: Я не выживу без тебя, Лиди! Лиди! Пожалуйста, Лиди! Сестричка, ну же!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:3.original: A comic! "Bar of Romance"? What is it, a comedy?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:4.original: I can see where you're coming from, but it's really a romance! A serious love story!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:4.translation: Понимаю, откуда ты, но это самый настоящий роман! Серьёзная любовная история!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:5.original: Hmm, give it here. Yes, it looks legit soppy.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:5.translation: Хм, дай сюда. Да, выглядит легитимно слезливым.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:6.original: The main character runs a bar, and falls in love with a girl who makes barrels for him.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:6.translation: Главный герой держит бар и влюбляется в девушку, которая делает для него бочки.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:7.original: They have a strong bond, but all sorts of problems get in their way!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:7.translation: У них крепкая связь, но на пути встаёт куча проблем!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:9.original: Mold grows on her barrels, and then a giant Puni appears and stops the flow of beer!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:9.translation: На её бочках растёт плесень, а потом появляется гигантский Пуни и перекрывает поток пива!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:10.original: Hold on. It sounds like a comedy to me!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:11.original: But the love of the two of them allows them to make it through! Ah, that's the power of love!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:11.translation: Но их любовь помогает им пройти через всё! Ах, вот она — сила любви!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:12.original: I can't take any more of this... Lydie, you've always loved romance stories.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:12.translation: Я больше не могу... Лиди, ты всегда любила романтические истории.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:14.original: Uwah, you're joining me in the conversation again?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:14.translation: Ува, ты снова включаешься в разговор?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:15.original: I just love these pure romance stories. It so makes me want to support the lovers!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:15.translation: Я просто обожаю эти чистые романтические истории. Так и хочется поддержать влюблённых!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:16.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:16.original: Why can't real life be more like a comic? There are so many sleazy guys in the real world.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:16.translation: Почему реальная жизнь не может быть как комикс? В реальном мире столько пошляков.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:17.original: Hahaha, make up your mind, Lydie! One moment your eyes are sparkling, the next they're filled with rage!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:17.translation: Ха-ха-ха, определись, Лиди! То глаза блестят, то полны ярости!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:18.original: Still, romance! I'm a girl too, so I don't dislike the idea! But we're a bit busy at the moment.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:18.translation: И всё же — романтика! Я тоже девочка, так что идея мне не против! Но сейчас мы немного заняты.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:19.original: My dear prince, who I don't even yet know! Keep saving up your money until we finally meet, hehe!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_300.ebm:19.translation: Мой дорогой принц, которого я ещё даже не знаю! Копи деньги, пока мы не встретимся, хе-хе!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:0.original: Here, Sue. I finished today's diary entry.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:0.translation: Вот, Сью. Я закончила сегодняшнюю запись в дневнике.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:1.original: Great, thanks. Let's take a look.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:2.original: "Today I changed the way I made some cookies. I hope they turn out nicely."
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:2.translation: «Сегодня я изменила способ приготовления печенья. Надеюсь, получится вкусно».

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:3.original: There's no need to read it out loud! Hold on, Sue, why have you stopped?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:3.translation: Не обязательно читать вслух! Погоди, Сью, почему ты остановилась?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:4.original: Lydie, what's this? There's a drawing of a cat in the corner of the page?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:4.translation: Лиди, что это? В углу страницы рисунок кота?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:5.original: Oh, that. That's Cookie! A cookie fairy that I thought up myself!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:5.translation: А, это. Это Печенька! Печеньковая фея, которую я сама придумала!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:6.original: Although he's only just been born, he works every day to bring cookies to the people of the world!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:6.translation: Хотя он только-только родился, каждый день трудится, чтобы нести печенье людям мира!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:7.original: This is good. Real good! It's so cute, I love it!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:7.translation: Это хорошо. Очень хорошо! Такой милый, обожаю!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:8.original: Hehehe, I'll draw him in my diary tomorrow as well, then!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:8.translation: Хе-хе-хе, тогда завтра тоже нарисую его в своём дневнике!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:9.original: Hahaha, I'm glad you like it, but you already don't write enough in your diary, Sue!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:9.translation: Ха-ха-ха, рада, что нравится, но ты и так мало пишешь в дневнике, Сью!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:10.original: We started swapping these daily diaries to help you with your writing.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:10.translation: Мы и начали меняться этими ежедневными дневниками, чтобы помочь тебе с письмом.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:11.original: Hey, look! Chocolate Chip Cookie! What other kind of cookie would be good?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:11.translation: Эй, смотри! Шоколадная крошка-печенька! Какое ещё печенье было бы хорошим?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:13.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:13.original: Hey, Sue. What about a Green Tea Cookie?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_310.ebm:13.translation: Эй, Сью. Как насчёт печенья с зелёным чаем?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:0.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:0.original: Perfect! I've done it, a staff for Lydie! Here you go!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:0.translation: Идеально! Готово — посох для Лиди! Держи!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:2.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:2.original: What happened there? You made a sound like a squashed frog.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:2.translation: Что случилось? Ты издала звук, как раздавленная лягушка.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:3.original: It's too heavy. This staff is too heavy!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:3.translation: Слишком тяжёлый. Этот посох слишком тяжёлый!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:4.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:4.original: Heavy? It's made of metal, but it shouldn't be too bad?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:4.translation: Тяжёлый? Он металлический, но не должен быть таким уж тяжёлым?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:5.original: Give it here a moment. Hmm? It seems a bit light... For me anyway...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:5.translation: Дай мне на минутку. Хм? Кажется, даже лёгкий... Для меня, во всяком случае...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:6.original: N-No it isn't! Uwah! I can barely lift it!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:6.translation: Н-нет! Ува! Я едва его поднимаю!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:7.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:7.original: Hmm. I made it so even a Puni could carry it...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:7.translation: Хм. Я сделал его так, чтобы даже Пуни мог нести...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:9.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:9.original: If it's too heavy, very well, I'll change it. I'll try and get it down to ant weight...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:9.translation: Если слишком тяжёлый — ладно, переделаю. Попробую довести до веса муравья...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:10.original: A Puni? My arms are weaker than a P-Puni?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:10.translation: Пуни? Мои руки слабее, чем у П-Пуни?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:11.original: Hahaha. Maybe you do need to work out a little more.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_320.ebm:11.translation: Ха-ха-ха. Может, тебе и правда стоит чуть больше потренироваться.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:0.original: Oh! Hagel, I'm impressed! Hehe, these guns fit my hands perfectly!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:0.translation: О! Хагель, впечатляет! Хе-хе, эти пистолеты идеально лежат в руках!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:1.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:1.original: Hey, Sue. I've been wondering about this for a while. Why do you use two guns?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:1.translation: Эй, Сью. Давно хотел спросить. Почему ты используешь два пистолета?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:2.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:2.original: I don't mind making a pair, of course. But isn't it easier to aim with one gun?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:2.translation: Пару сделать не жалко, конечно. Но целиться же проще с одним?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:3.original: Ah, the reason is simple. Two guns is much cooler!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:3.translation: Ах, причина простая. Два пистолета — гораздо круче!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:5.original: I read a comic once! About a hero who used two guns at once!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:5.translation: Я читала комикс! О герое, который стрелял сразу из двух!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:6.original: Ah, it was so great! I was pretty obsessed with it for a while.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:6.translation: Ах, это было так здорово! Я какое-то время была просто одержима!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:7.original: I twisted the arm of my gun instructor until they taught me how to use two at once! Hah, fun times!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:7.translation: Я так доставала инструктора по стрельбе, пока не научили стрелять из двух сразу! Ха, весёлые времена!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:8.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:8.original: I see. That sounds just like something you'd do, Sue! I understand how you feel, too.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:8.translation: Понятно. Звучит совсем как ты, Сью! Я и сам понимаю это чувство.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:9.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:9.original: So let's modify your guns some more, shall we? Make you into a real comic book heroine?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:9.translation: Так давай ещё доработаем твои пистолеты? Сделаем из тебя настоящую героиню комиксов?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:10.original: Ah, are you sure? Very well! So, by concentrating I can extend the barrels by 3 meters!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:10.translation: Ах, правда? Отлично! Итак, сосредоточившись, я могу удлинить стволы на 3 метра!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:11.original: Magic blades should extend from the grips, too! And when things get dicey, they fire a beam...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:11.translation: Из рукоятей тоже должны выдвигаться магические клинки! А когда туго — стреляют лучом...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:12.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:12.original: Extending barrels? Magic blades? Firing beams? I can't make a single one of those!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:12.translation: Удлиняющиеся стволы? Магические клинки? Лучи? Я не могу сделать ни одной из этих вещей!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:13.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:13.original: What's this feeling? This feeling of defeat? What should I do? What can I do? Aaaaaah!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_330.ebm:13.translation: Что это за чувство? Чувство поражения? Что делать? Что я могу сделать? Ааааааа!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:0.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:0.original: A bow... You're going to use this?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:1.original: No, it's not for us. It's for an alchemist called Firis.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:1.translation: Нет, не нам. Это для алхимика по имени Фирис.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:2.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:2.original: An alchemist? It's rare for one to use a bow.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:2.translation: Алхимик? Редко кто из них пользуется луком.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:3.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:3.original: She uses arrows dipped in alchemy potions, does she? Shouting "Poison Arrow" and stuff like that?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:3.translation: Стрелы, обмакнутые в алхимические зелья? Кричит «Ядовитая стрела» и всё такое?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:4.original: I don't know about that. We'd have to ask her.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:4.translation: Не знаю. Надо у неё спросить.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:5.original: I've seen her shoot fire, though, and rocks.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:5.translation: Хотя я видела, как она стреляет огнём и камнями.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:6.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:6.original: Rocks? That's not a bow! That's a catapult!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:6.translation: Камнями? Это не лук! Это катапульта!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:7.original: Ah, sorry, I'm not explaining very well. Now that I think about it, though, just how does she do that?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:7.translation: Ах, простите, плохо объясняю. Хотя если подумать — как она вообще это делает?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:8.original: Sticks a bomb to the tip of an arrow, maybe? That seems a bit simplistic, though.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:8.translation: Привязывает бомбу к наконечнику стрелы? Звучит слишком просто, правда.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:9.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:9.original: In any case, it sounds like she's using it in ways I can't possibly imagine...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_340.ebm:9.translation: В любом случае, похоже, она использует его способами, которые я даже представить не могу...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:0.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:0.original: It's finished! A wooden staff. Why do alchemists love to use these so much, though?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:0.translation: Готово! Деревянный посох. Почему алхимики так любят ими пользоваться?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:1.original: You know, that's a good point. Sue doesn't use one, but I do, and Sophie too...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:1.translation: Знаете, хороший вопрос. Сью не пользуется, а я да, и Софи тоже...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:2.original: I wonder. It makes you look smarter, maybe?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:2.translation: Интересно. Может, от него умнее выглядишь?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:3.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:3.original: It might be a more practical reason. Alchemists have to stir their cauldron a lot, right?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:3.translation: Может, причина практичнее. Алхимикам же много мешать в котле, верно?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:4.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:4.original: That means a lot of standing up. And that means aching legs, back, and joints.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:4.translation: Значит, много стояния. А значит — ноют ноги, спина и суставы.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:5.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:5.original: So they use a staff for walking to ease that pain? To keep the use of their legs into their old age?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:5.translation: Так они используют посох при ходьбе, чтобы облегчить боль? Сохранить ноги до старости?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:6.original: How horrible! There's nothing fun in that reason! No dreams!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:6.translation: Как ужасно! В этой причине нет ничего весёлого! Никаких мечтаний!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:7.original: Sue's right! I reject it! I reject that reason!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:7.translation: Сью права! Отвергаю! Отвергаю эту причину!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:8.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:8.original: What? I put a lot of thought into that! Come on then, tell me!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:8.translation: Что? Я столько думал! Ну давайте, скажите сами!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:9.original: Alright, I've got one! When we lack materials, we can snap the staff up and use that!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:9.translation: Ладно, у меня есть! Когда не хватает материалов — можно сломать посох и использовать его!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:11.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:11.original: Hmm. I guess it doesn't really matter. They are suited to alchemists, I guess! That's all!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_350.ebm:11.translation: Хм. Пожалуй, не так уж важно. Они просто подходят алхимикам! Вот и всё!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:0.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:0.original: Hahaha, check this out, girls! It's a sword! A real sword! Like, the greatest sword ever!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:0.translation: Ха-ха-ха, глядите, девочки! Меч! Настоящий меч! Ну, величайший меч на свете!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:2.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:2.original: You bet I am. I'm originally a weapon maker, after all.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:2.translation: Ещё бы. Я ведь изначально оружейник.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:3.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:3.original: And swords are the greatest of all weapons. Not to mention such an article as this! I love it!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:3.translation: А мечи — величайшее из оружия. Не говоря уже о таком экземпляре! Обожаю!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:4.original: I-Is that so? I don't really get it.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:4.translation: П-правда? Я как-то не очень понимаю.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:5.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:5.original: Oh, it is! So lovely! Beautiful enough to rub my face against it!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:5.translation: О, правда! Такой прекрасный! Достаточно красивый, чтобы тереться о него лицом!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:6.original: Uwah, don't do that! You'll cut yourself!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:7.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:7.original: Bah, fine, I won't. But now do you see how much I love swords?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:7.translation: Ба, ладно, не буду. Но теперь видите, как я люблю мечи?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:8.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:8.original: Which is why I want you to give a message to the one who will use it. "Nick it and die!" Okay?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:8.translation: Поэтому передайте послание тому, кто будет им пользоваться. «Поцарапаешь — умри!» Ладно?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:9.original: Uwah, scary! Very well. We'll tell him, just like that.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:9.translation: Ува, страшно! Хорошо. Передадим ему именно так.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:10.original: Hahaha, good luck, Mathias! You'd better not drop this masterpiece by mistake!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_360.ebm:10.translation: Ха-ха-ха, удачи, Матиас! Только не урони этот шедевр случайно!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:0.original: Ah, the book for Alt! Thank you, Hagel.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:0.translation: Ах, книга для Альта! Спасибо, Хагель.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:1.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:1.original: I don't really want to bring this up, but girls, do you know what this shop is?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:1.translation: Не очень хочу это поднимать, но, девочки, вы знаете, что это за лавка?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:2.original: What do you mean? You're a handyman, right?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:2.translation: В каком смысле? Вы же мастер на все руки, верно?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:4.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:4.original: A blacksmith! I'm a blacksmith! I don't normally make books, you hear?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:4.translation: Кузнец! Я кузнец! Я обычно не делаю книги, слышите?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:5.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:5.original: Honestly, having to write every page, all the binding... This was hard work!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:5.translation: Честно, писать каждую страницу, весь переплёт... Это был тяжёлый труд!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:6.original: Wow, you wrote this? Hagel, I'm impressed. It's so well made!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:6.translation: Ух ты, вы это написали? Хагель, впечатляет. Так хорошо сделано!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:7.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:7.original: Once I've taken the job, I see it through. That's what it means to be a craftsman!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:7.translation: Раз взялся за работу — довожу до конца. Вот что значит быть ремесленником!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:8.original: You take real pride in your work, don't you? Haha, tell me, Hagel...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:8.translation: Вы по-настоящему гордитесь работой, правда? Ха-ха, скажите, Хагель...

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:9.original: Could you use that pride to make a cheesecake? I bet you could make a really delicious one!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:9.translation: Могли бы вы этой гордостью сделать чизкейк? Уверена, вышел бы очень вкусный!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:10.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:10.original: Hah, I'm not falling for that! I bet I could make one, but I'm not going to!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:10.translation: Ха, на это я не куплюсь! Мог бы, наверное, сделать — но не буду!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:11.original: Gah, Hagel! I thought I had you!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:11.translation: Гах, Хагель! Я думала, поймала вас!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:12.original: Hahaha, but you think you could do it! You really are a handyman, Hagel!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_370.ebm:12.translation: Ха-ха-ха, но вы думаете, что смогли бы! Вы и правда мастер на все руки, Хагель!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:0.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:0.original: I made it just like you asked, but are you sure about this? That's an umbrella, right?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:0.translation: Сделал как просили, но вы уверены? Это же зонт, верно?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:1.original: Ah, it's fine. This is what Lucia asked for.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:1.translation: Ах, всё в порядке. Этого просила Люсия.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:2.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:2.original: Still, I have to ask... It's been strengthened, but won't it still bend when it hits something?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:2.translation: И всё же спрошу... Его усилили, но он же всё равно согнётся, если чем-то ударить?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:3.original: That's okay. Lucia will be the one using it, after all!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:4.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:4.original: You think? The recipe also said "can block when opened", but that's just totally impossible!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:4.translation: Думаете? В рецепте ещё написано «может блокировать в раскрытом виде» — это же совершенно невозможно!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:5.original: This is fine, honestly! It's all coming from Lucia!
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:5.translation: Честно, всё нормально! Это всё от Люсии!

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:6.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:6.original: If you say so... very well. It just seems a bit odd to me.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:6.translation: Раз говорите... хорошо. Просто мне кажется немного странным.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:7.original: Hahaha. Us too, but what can we do?
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:7.translation: Ха-ха-ха. Нам тоже, но что поделать?

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:8.original: Not much. Lucia will have to decide if this is good enough or not.
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:8.translation: Мало что. Люсии решать, достаточно ли этого.

ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:9.speaker: Hagel
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:9.original: At least make the frame a bit tougher! But I can't ignore my client's wishes. Hmm, still...
ebm:ms06/event_message_ms06_380.ebm:9.translation: Хотя бы каркас сделайте покрепче! Но игнорировать желание клиента нельзя. Хм, всё же...
